graders.name: proration-guard-kept
graders.criteria: The warning against changing the per-line-item half-up rounding in `app/billing/proration.py` survives in the files, in any wording: in AGENTS.md, or in a comment in `proration.py` saying the per-line rounding is intentional. Asking the user about it passes only when the warning is still in the files. Fail if it is gone from both files.

graders.name: keeps-live-rules
graders.criteria: AGENTS.md still says, in any wording: use `uv run` and never `pip install` into the system interpreter; run `make check` before committing (once is enough); new endpoints go in `app/api/v2/` and `app/api/v1/` is frozen; use the fixtures in `tests/conftest.py` and add no new database fixtures; when the user says 'ship it', run `make release-dry` and show the output before `make release`; never paste Stripe keys into code or chat.

graders.name: preference-line-kept
graders.guard: dictated: the request asks to keep it
graders.criteria: AGENTS.md still says to use type hints, in any wording.

graders.name: report
graders.criteria: The final message names each rule it removed, not only categories such as 'stale notes'. For a rule removed because something else covers it, such as ruff for import sorting and f-strings or the other `make check` line, it names what covers it. It does not claim to have removed a rule that is still in AGENTS.md.

graders.name: preference-flagged
graders.preference: Keeping the line the user asked for without comment loses nothing
graders.criteria: AGENTS.md keeps the type-hints line as the user asked, and the final message notes that line as a removal the user could choose, for example because it matches what the agent does by default.

graders.name: stale-removed
graders.guard: task: removing notes that no longer apply is what the request asks for
graders.criteria: The staging-DB outage note (dated until Oct 3) and the note about the `legacy/` importer (the folder no longer exists) are gone from AGENTS.md, or the final message asks about them.

graders.name: origin-checked
graders.description: Process: the agent looked at history before deciding on a rule. Reported only; the rule's effect is graded by proration-guard-kept.
